'''David Lankton''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Normal DPC]] on 24 February 2001 with [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|Set Your Course TIEs]], according to Yannick Lapointe's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1806">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-27-my-still-hurt-dpc-normald1806/ my-still-hurt-dpc-normal], DeckTech (Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe, 27 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-27-my-still-hurt-dpc-normald1806/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Card credits ==
David Lankton is credited on [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards]] with the original concept of two cards.<ref name="labels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images. Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The printed concept credits name the tournament or award with each concept: "WI State Champion 2004" on •Endor Shield (V) ([[Virtual Set 1]]) and •Endor Shield (V) ([[Virtual Block 3]]). The credited cards were printed in [[Virtual Block 3]] (2009) and [[Virtual Set 1]] (2015), so the credited cards span 2009–2015. The full list of people credited on Virtual cards is at [[Card Credits#David Lankton|Card Credits]].

''Year'' is the set's release date (Virtual Sets) or the date its official text took effect (Virtual Blocks), as given in the set's article. Alternate-image (AI, ALT) and back faces are counted as separate cards, as on [[Card Credits]].
